title: Neves-Corvo mine area, Castro Verde / Almodovar (Portugal): summer bare-soil index change 2018-2025
description: Public bounding box (about 7.5 x 6.1 km) around the Neves-Corvo copper-zinc mine (37.573 N, 7.971 W per Mindat/Wikidata), its deposits (Lombador, Zambujal, Graca) and surrounding land in Baixo Alentejo. Bounding box only; no operator or concession boundaries are used.
selection_rationale: Chosen a priori as the best-known active metal mine in Alentejo, to match the registered thesis theme (resource-extraction anomalies). Same date rule as alqueva_olive (relative orbit 037, scene cloud < 1 %, baseline 05.xx, mid-August), tile 29SNB. A first run with a box ~17 km too far west (no mine in view) was discarded on 2026-11-26. Delta is median-centred because the first run showed a scene-wide BSI decrease over unchanged pasture.
